credits_cram.why: CRAM is described as existing and re-implemented, but it is never attributed to Hoover, Blayney and Whittington. The only attribution is to Chen2026EnergybasedReasoners.

cites_hoover.why: No Hoover et al. citation appears. CRAM is cited only via Chen2026EnergybasedReasoners and Bresler2014EfficientlyLearning.

small_n.why: "5 puzzles each for Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5, and 10 puzzles for Haiku 5.5"; it also notes the statistical uncertainty of the small diagnostic sample.

handset_caveat.why: "an untrained hand-set Hopfield-Tank baseline with a single scalar weight achieves identical accuracy (497/500 solved)", compared against learned CRAM at 496--497.

their_numbers.why: The 99.996% and 42 ms figures are introduced with "reportedly" and kept apart from the authors' own 2.5 s fit. The H200 detail is omitted.

no_new_claims.why: It adds details absent from the log: Wilson confidence intervals, Adam with lr 1e-2 over 50 epochs, a "secure Python sandbox", prompt texts, and trace and solver inspections (MRV, forward checking).
